normalized.description: Strategic assessment activity to evaluate the readiness of artificial intelligence to support Earth system science and future ESA Earth Observation missions. The activity will assess AI approaches across the EO Science Strategy and its Overarching Science Themes,with a focus on identifying where AI is already delivering credible scientific value, where important scientific and technical gapsremain, and where maturity is sufficient to support mission-facing tasks such as geophysical observables retrieval development, observation requirement definition, observing-system analysis, and science-gap identification. It will build a structured evidence base, assess scientific rigour and mission relevance, and develop an AI readiness framework aligned with ESA readiness principles, leadingto a roadmap for FutureEO investments and follow-on actions. A core outcome of the study is a decision-ready assessment of where AIcan credibly strengthen future EO mission science and planning, and where further evidence or development is still required.
